configurations.judgment: RETAIN_CANONICAL_AUTHORITY. Approved list unchanged and the comparison anchor: 30 physical lands, 9 static rocks (39 static sources), 37 nonlegendary artifacts, 17 power-2+ creature cards as casualty fodder, avg MV 3.406. Registry recorded digest equals the raw bytes (no provenance exception).

PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL. +Skullclamp +Piggy Bank +Razorlash Transmogrant +Necron Deathmark +Royal Warden / -Fellwar Stone -Reckless Fireweaver -Thoughtcast -Marionette Master -Thopter Spy Network. 30 lands + 8 rocks; nonlegendary artifacts 37->41, power-2+ fodder 17->21. Adds the conditional three-card Razorlash+Pitiless Plunderer+Phyrexian Altar loop (Commander Spellbook 4050-4871-6429; needs an opponent with >=4 nonbasic lands), disclosed. Loses Marionette Master's drain and one rock.

REJECT (same-count alternative, staged). Same five adds but cuts Disciple of the Vault instead of Thoughtcast. Disciple is the drain payoff for casualty/sacrifice loops including the new Razorlash loop; keeping Thoughtcast does not compensate. MODERATE confidence.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (six-swap, staged, not selected). Preferred five + Cyberman Patrol over Ichor Wellspring. Adds another artifact creature body for casualty, but Wellspring's draw on entering and dying is worth more card flow. MODERATE confidence.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (six-swap, staged, not selected; Treasure Keeper is off-ranked on EDHREC). Preferred five + Treasure Keeper over Auton Soldier. Death trigger casts a free MV<=3 nonland card and is good casualty fodder, but Auton Soldier has the higher ceiling. LOW_WITH_DISCLOSED_LIMITS.

STAGED_NOT_SELECTED. Both six-swap alternatives together (Patrol over Wellspring, Treasure Keeper over Auton Soldier). Neither change beat its incumbent alone, so stacking them would be padding; five is a floor, not a target.

scope_caveat: Local comparison over these six explicit complete 100-card configurations plus named single-card contenders in the M7 packet; not a global or mathematical optimum and not a win-rate measurement.
